pages.speaker: tourist
lines: おねがいです！ たすけてください！

pages.speaker: tourist
lines: たいせつな ポケモンちゃんが ぬすまれて しまったんです！

pages.speaker: looker
lines: Oho! What have we here? One of our fair city's famous tourists!

pages.speaker: looker
lines: From your manner of speaking, madame, I deduce that you have traveled far indeed!

pages.speaker: looker
lines: I am...Looker. What may I do for you?

pages.speaker: tourist
lines: わたしの ことばが わかるんですね ああ よかった！ たすかります！

pages.speaker: tourist
lines: わたし このくにの ことばは ヒアリングしか できなくて！

pages.speaker: tourist
lines: じつは えきで わたしの たいせつな ポケモンちゃんたちが ぬすまれて！

pages.speaker: tourist
lines: それで ここが たんていじむしょ だって きいたから うかがったんですよ！

pages.speaker: tourist
lines: どうか おねがいします！ いますぐ わたしの ポケモンちゃんを とりかえして いただけませんか？

pages.speaker: looker
lines: Ahem... My dear lady...

pages.speaker: looker
lines: I am so terribly sorry, but could you speak a bit less quickly?

pages.speaker: tourist
lines: すっ すいません…… でも いそいでるんですよ！

pages.speaker: tourist
lines: たいせつな ポケモンちゃんを とりかえさないと そこく に かえることも できません！

pages.speaker: tourist
lines: ひこうきの じかん だって せまって きているんですよ！

pages.speaker: looker
lines: Ahem... From what I can gather, it seems that this lady has been given sore offense.

lines.expression: 'And do you know why that would be, ' + q.player.username + ', my friend?';

pages.speaker: looker
lines: Well, thanks to my gift for languages-- I've traveled all over the world, you know...

pages.speaker: looker
lines: It seems she is highly offended that she has come as a guest and not yet been offered tea! Yes! Case closed!

pages.speaker: looker
lines: Which means, my friend, I must make haste to obtain the requisite tea!

lines.expression: '' + q.player.username + ', please keep our guest company until my return from this vital mission.';

pages.speaker: tourist
lines: ちょっと なんなのよ！ あの ひと！！

pages.speaker: tourist
lines: ぜんぜん わかってないじゃない！ わたしは のんきに おちゃ なんて のんでる ばあいでは ないんです！

pages.speaker: tourist
lines: はやく ポケモンちゃんを たすけて！

pages.speaker: emma
lines: I'm home, Mr. Looker!

pages.speaker: emma
lines: Is Mr. Looker out? And who's this old lady?

pages.speaker: tourist
lines: ちょっと なんなの この こ！ オバサンなんて しつれいねっ！！

pages.speaker: tourist
lines: みなりが きたない にんげんは ことば まで けがれているわね！

pages.speaker: tourist
lines: さっき でていった ルッカー とかいう バカな おとこの こども かしら？

pages.speaker: emma
lines: ……ちょっと オバサン なんて こと いうの……？

pages.speaker: emma
lines: あたしのことは どうでも いい…… けど ルッカーおじさん のこと わるく いうのは ゆるさない……

pages.speaker: emma
lines: ……それにさ あたしが おじさんの こどもの わけ ないよ ……おじさんに しつれい だよ

pages.speaker: tourist
lines: まっ！？ あなた わたしの ことばが わかるの？

pages.speaker: emma
lines: うん…… まあね……

pages.speaker: emma
lines: だいたいで なんとなく だけど このまち

pages.speaker: emma
lines: って おそとに いると いろんな くにの ことばで おはなし してるのが きこえるから いつのまにか おぼえちゃったの

lines.expression: 'Hmm... If we keep going like this, then ' + q.player.username + ' is gonna be totally lost...';

pages.speaker: emma
lines: And I don't feel like opening up the trash talk with this old lady again...

pages.speaker: emma
lines: Hey, Mimi! How about it? Do you think you can help us out with your power?

pages.speaker: tourist
lines: きもちに よゆうが なかったんです いのちより だいじな ポケモンちゃんを ぬすまれて こんらん してしまって……

pages.speaker: player
lines: Is this Mimi's mystical power? Somehow you can hear the strange woman's thoughts in your head...

pages.speaker: player
lines: ... ... ... It seems she feels sorry for saying rude things about Looker and Emma.

pages.speaker: player
lines: ... ... ... And the real reason she is so troubled is that her precious Pokémon were stolen!

pages.speaker: tourist
lines: このまちの えきで！ ガラの わるい れんちゅうが あゆみよったら

pages.speaker: tourist
lines: つぎの しゅんかんに バッグと なかに いれた ボールが ぬすまれました！

pages.speaker: player
lines: She was walking through the train station when it happened...

pages.speaker: player
lines: ... ... ... A man sneaked up behind her, and then he stole her Bag.

pages.speaker: player
lines: ... ... ... The woman did her best to chase him, but he got away...

pages.speaker: emma
lines: ……えき ……ガラの わるい れんちゅう もしかして……

pages.speaker: emma
lines: あのこ たち かな？

pages.speaker: player
lines: ... ... ... It seems that Emma has some idea of who the man might have been...

pages.speaker: looker

pages.speaker: looker
lines: Oh! What have we here? Mimi! Are you happy to see me come home, too?

pages.speaker: looker
lines: Why... I wondered if it would ever happen. I have won over the hard-boiled Mimi!

pages.speaker: emma
lines: Um, Mr. Looker? This old lady here says her Pokémon were stolen.

pages.speaker: emma
lines: I'd guess the thieves are still in Lumiose Station...

pages.speaker: looker
lines: What's that? What's that you're saying? Then it wasn't tea that she was after?

pages.speaker: looker
lines: But I bought this...fancy...expensive...

pages.speaker: looker
lines: No! Hah! Never mind that! Let us focus on what is most important now!

pages.speaker: looker
lines: Come, my friends! We have a case!

pages.speaker: emma
lines: Just a minute, Mr. Looker.

pages.speaker: looker
lines: What is it, Emma? Didn't you hear?

pages.speaker: looker
lines: Her Pokémon have been stolen! We must get them back at once!

pages.speaker: emma
lines: I'd bet anything that the guy who stole this old lady's Pokémon was part of the Lumiose Gang.

pages.speaker: emma
lines: They're rough types, you know?

pages.speaker: emma
lines: If we stick our noses in, that means a battle for sure...

pages.speaker: looker
lines: Pardon? Whom? The Lumiose Gang?

pages.speaker: emma
lines: Yeah. So let's drop it, OK?

pages.speaker: emma
lines: You know, that old lady was talking trash about you while you were out.

pages.speaker: emma
lines: She ain't nice. It's not worth having a great big fight to help a person like her.
